messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — were enabling the tenant-segmentation feature for Private/VPC customers starting next Tue (2026-06-01) at 09:00 PT. This adds per-tenant network isolation and enforced KMS key scoping. Docs + rollout checklist below.

devon: Timeline + rollout plan? will this be opt-in or forced? :thinking:

maria: Rollout plan = phased. Week 1: opt-in beta for customers on Dedicated & Private with active support tickets. Week 2: opt-in for all new Private signups. Week 4: auto-enforce for customers who opted into >=2 security controls. Well notify customers 7 days before auto-enforcement.

sara: For PS: what do we need to send customers? migration steps / config sample?

maria: Yes. Weve got a short migration snippet:

```
# example: enable tenant seg in private-config.yaml
tenant_segmentation:
  enabled: true
  kms_scope: customer-key
  network_policy: strict
```

Link to doc: https://intranet.redwood/company/private/tenant-segmentation

ben-ps: Ill prepare a one-pager and a 15-min customer webinar slot. ETA EOD Wed.

sam-security: Important: audit logging and S3 bucket isolation need to be default ON for segmented tenants. Are we gating any customers from early rollout due to compliance gaps?

maria: Good call. Customers lacking KMS integration or using legacy SSO will be blocked from auto-enforce. PS will get a pre-check script; well surface blockers in the console.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: tenant-seg-feature-toggle -> canary -> 2026-05-30 02:00 UTC. Rollback window: 2 hours.

devon: Any perf impact? token/p95 latency concerns?

maria: Expected <5% p95 delta; well monitor with a dedicated dashboard. If p95 increases >10% well pause rollout and revert canary.

sara: Noted. PS will run the pre-checks for customers on our active rollout list and raise tickets for any blockers.

ben-ps: +1. Ill coordinate webinar invites.

maria: Thanks all — please skim the doc and add comments. Ill post a final announcement to #customer-success and #support once canary looks stable. :rocket:
